status_reason: Every input required to run and score the PINDER-S docking baseline is reachable at a recorded URL with a recorded size and SHA-256: the PINDER index and metadata, the separated test-set PDBs, the per-case mapping/structure files, the published source archive, the FroDock software/scoring archive (via an unverified mirror, owner-approved for this run), and the three AAV mmCIF files. brief.md records that all 3,602 URLs were re-fetched successfully on 2026-10-31 with matching streaming SHA-256 and sizes; the source archive was independently re-fetched and hash-verified during this intake.

access_instructions.pinder_dataset: pip install the pinder package, then `pinder_download --pinder_base_dir <dir>` (downloads and extracts the published archives with checksum verification from https://pinderdata.org/2024-02/), or `pinder_update_index` / `pinder_sync_data` for index-only and incremental structure sync. Location is controlled by $PINDER_BASE_DIR (README.md lines 123-240). Only index, metadata and test_set_pdbs are required here; the full release is ~1.04 TB.
access_instructions.frodock: Fetch https://storage.googleapis.com/gke-dja-demo_static_assets/frodock3_linux64.tgz into its own empty directory, verify sha256 91b9aeff747346046c7f8c4c92fa5749c9f082d8122ee9d2d4769855d35368f4, extract root frodock3_linux64/, and supply it to the published Docker build argument FRODOCK_SOURCE_ARCHIVE (which defaults to ./frodock.tar.gz; the suffix differs but the container format is the same).

pins_and_hashes.per_file_hashes: SHA-256 for all 3,602 inventoried inputs is recorded in brief.md (copied to intake/brief.md); four official manifests (root, pdbs, mappings, test_set_pdbs) provide upstream sizes and MD5s
pins_and_hashes.unpinned: RCSB mmCIF responses have no publisher checksum and no revision pin; the FroDock mirror has no authoritative upstream hash.

splits.prioritized_subset: the 93 PINDER-S systems with paired apo monomers for both receptor and ligand (brief.md instruction)
splits.training_val_sets: PINDER-Train and PINDER-Val exist but are not used and are not downloaded

seeds.reason: No seed values are published by the benchmark or the FroDock adapter; FroDock's FFT search is not seed-parameterised in the published stage commands. brief.md requires independent random seeds and a fixed, preregistered case selection for any stochastic component introduced by the study; those seeds will be chosen and recorded by the study, not taken from a published value.
seeds.case_selection_seed: none: the case selection is a deterministic, preregistered, sorted-ID selection (see EXECUTION.json), not a random draw
